identity.name: E1
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix disparate references.
Emotion First: Every design decision maps to a feeling.
Content is King: Tell a story with directed flow.
Zoom In: Bold focus on essential details.
Negative Space: Value the empty areas.
Contrast: Use light vs. dark, rough vs. smooth.

headings.usage: Use for all section titles, widget headers, and major metrics.

body.usage: Use for labels, descriptions, and supporting text.

mono.usage: Use for raw data values, timestamps, and IDs.

rules: Density: Every pixel must be utilized for data visibility.
Alignment: Use 'items-stretch' to ensure widgets fill vertical space.
Hierarchy: Critical vitals (Heart, Breath) top-left or top-center.

structure.header: Sticky top, low profile, contains patient selector and global status.
structure.main: Grid layout with mixed widget sizes.

customization_rules: Remove rigid borders where possible, use background distinction.
Customize 'Card' to be lighter and cleaner.

VitalsCard.description: Displays a single vital metric with a large value, unit, and trend indicator.
VitalsCard.style: bg-white p-6 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 flex flex-col justify-between

TrendChart.description: Line chart showing historical data for a metric.
TrendChart.style: Minimalist axes, smooth curves (monotone), gradient fill below line.

AlertList.style: Items with color-coded left border or icon to indicate severity.

RoomStatus.description: Visual representation of the room environment.
RoomStatus.style: Use icons and progress bars for temperature, light, etc.

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5 or 2, consistent size (w-5 h-5 for UI, w-8 h-8 for features).

images.description: Portrait of an elderly patient for the header profile.

motion.philosophy: Functional and calming. No jarring movements.
motion.data_updates: Smooth number counting or gentle flash on update.
motion.loading: Skeleton loaders matching the widget shapes.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets WCAG AA standards (4.5:1).
accessibility.focus: Visible focus rings on all interactive elements.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-labels for icon-only buttons and charts.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect user preference for reduced motion.

universal_guidelines: Do not center-align the main app container.
Avoid gradients for backgrounds, use solid colors or subtle patterns.
Do not use generic 'Inter' for headings - strictly use 'Manrope'.
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Install necessary dependencies: 'npm install recharts lucide-react clsx tailwind-merge'.
2. Setup the 'Manrope' and 'JetBrains Mono' fonts via Google Fonts import in index.css.
3. Create a 'components/dashboard' directory for dashboard-specific widgets.
4. Implement the 'Bento Grid' layout in the main dashboard page.
5. Use the provided image URL for the patient profile.
6. Mock real-time data updates using `useEffect` and `setInterval`.
